skill.displayName: 小红书评论分析与需求挖掘

llm.summary: This skill is a disclosed, read-only SocialDataX integration for analyzing Xiaohongshu comments using a user-provided API key.

dimensions.detail: The requested SOCIALDATAX_API_KEY, node, npm, network access, and hosted SocialDataX API calls are proportionate for retrieving social media comment data; the artifact explicitly says it does not read local browser data or perform login/account actions.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill uses Node/npm and npx to run the socialdatax-skills package from npm; the inspected package metadata declares no npm lifecycle install scripts, but @latest remains a mutable external package reference.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Instructions disclose pagination, optional broader collection with --all or --pages, expected JSON outputs, and analysis boundaries such as separating visible comment evidence from conclusions.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No background persistence, privilege escalation, local credential storage, posting, liking, commenting, or account modification is instructed by the artifact.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose is Xiaohongshu comment analysis and demand/feedback extraction, and the runtime examples are limited to fetching comments or comment replies from a note URL, note_id, or comment_id.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you are comfortable sending the provided Xiaohongshu URL or IDs, pagination tokens, and your SocialDataX API key to SocialDataX-hosted services. Use --pages or --max-items instead of --all when you want bounded collection.
